def axis(k, v, h, mean, adv, sign):
    from scipy.sparse import diags
    k = (k[:-1] + k[1:]) / 2 if mean == 0 else 2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / (k[:-1] + k[1:])
    d = k / h ** 2
    v = v * sign / h
    a = (v[:-1] + v[1:]) / 2
    pos = np.maximum(a, 0)
    neg = np.minimum(a, 0)
    if adv == 0:
        lo = -d - pos
        hi = -d + neg
        mid = np.r_[d + pos, 0] + np.r_[0, d - neg]
    if adv == 1:
        lo = -d - pos
        hi = -d + neg
        mid = -np.r_[hi, 0] - np.r_[0, lo]
    if adv == 2:
        lo = -d - np.maximum(v[1:], 0)
        hi = -d + np.minimum(v[:-1], 0)
        mid = -np.r_[hi, 0] - np.r_[0, lo]
    if adv == 3:
        lo = -d - np.maximum(v[:-1], 0)
        hi = -d + np.minimum(v[1:], 0)
        mid = np.r_[d + np.maximum(v[:-1], 0), 0] + np.r_[0, d - np.minimum(v[1:], 0)]
    return diags([lo, mid, hi], [-1, 0, 1], format='csc')
